verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's large layered circles and reads left to right (product, brand/headline, CTA). However, the bag almost touches the top and bottom edges, the headline sits jammed against an oversized CTA pill, and the right side of the banner is crowded. B spaces the text better, but it shrinks the signature circles into small dots that float at random (the olive one sits under the headline), which loses the original's feel. B's bag also sits against the bottom edge, and its smaller CTA crowds the right edge.
